title: Mayor Gloria, Community HousingWorks Break Ground on Affordable Housing Development in Serra Mesa
description:
To bring more affordable housing to San Diego, San Diego Mayor Todd Gloria and Community HousingWorks (CHW) are breaking ground on Serra Mesa Apartments, CHW's newest affordable housing community serving low-income households and veterans.
 
By combining permanent affordable housing with on-site services, the community is designed to promote long-term housing stability and overall well-being. The 60-unit development is located less than half a mile from a Veterans Affairs clinic, offering convenient access to health care, supportive services and case management through the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs.
